messages:
alex: quick help please — a new user ran the minimal quickstart and got 402 on first API call even though the console shows a card and billing active 🤔

alex: repro they sent:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-live-abc...\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"model\":\"echo-small\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'
```

alex: response body:
```json
{"error":"payment_required","message":"workspace billing inactive"}
```

mira: can you paste org id (obfuscate) and whether they created the workspace via the UI or joined an org? Also which region the API call targeted?

alex: org: org_Q4p...t2, user: new@company.com, created via UI, region: eu-central-1

onboarding-bot: New workspace org_Q4p...t2 created 2026-06-01T09:12:04Z. Billing webhook status: succeeded. Link job status: linked_pending_confirmation.

infra-bot: Stripe webhook received: payment_intent.succeeded for pi_777 at 2026-06-01T09:12:02Z. Billing link job queued job_889.

mira: sounds like a link job race. Quick support workaround: run redwoodctl billing reconcile --org org_Q4p...t2 or create a workspace-scoped API token and retry (workspace tokens are tied to org billing context).

support: ran reconcile:
$ redwoodctl billing reconcile --org org_Q4p...t2
Reconciling... success. org status -> active

alex: retried quickstart after reconcile and got 200: {"id":"r_001","output":"hi"} :tada: user confirmed app works.

mira: follow-up action: we'll add a short delay/confirmation in the UI before showing \"billing active\" so the link job completes, and add server-side retry for the link worker. Filing prod-bug DX-2026 and adding a KB entry for support.

support: note for KB: if you get 402 during quickstart after adding card, run redwoodctl billing reconcile --org <org> or generate a workspace token and retry.

alex: closing the user ticket, tagging @mira to track the UI + worker fixes. thanks all 🙏
